No comments have been received from the public in response to the notices published by the petitioner under Section 64 of the Act. TANGEDCO has filed reply via affidavit dated 21.05.2018 to the petition. The petitioner has submitted the rejoinder vide affidavit dated 11.10.2018. The hearing in this matter was held on 24.05.2018 & 23.10.2018. The petitioner was directed to file certain information vide ROP of hearing dated 24.05.2018. In response, the petitioner has submitted the information vide affidavit dated 16.07.2018.
